# Findings (auto-generated from the dataset, snapshot 2026-10-22)

Generated by `scripts/run_analysis.py`; every number below is computed from `data/processed/eda_tools_clean.csv`. It describes the collected catalog, not every EDA tool in the world.

- Tools in the dataset: **558** (from 1045 source records; 357 tools combine several sources)
- Licence model: commercial **76**, open-source **308**, freeware **7**, unknown **167**
- Largest primary category: **simulation (145)**; categories covered: 11 of 11
- Regions with documented vendor origin: North America 54, Europe 8, Asia 4, Oceania 3

- Vendor concentration: the top 3 vendors account for **7%** of the tools that name a vendor
- Tools with a release in the last 3 years (2024-2026): 37 of 69 with a documented release
- Earliest documented first release: 1973
- Least complete fields: first_release_year 8% filled, supported_platforms 12% filled, latest_version 12% filled
